diagnosis: C5 is exactly redundant with C2. In addition, no check verifies the required restitution and privacy-compliant customer-notice commitments, so a settlement can pass all checks while omitting those commitments.
evidence: C2 and C5 are both `decisions['restitution_amount'] == 185000`; acceptance condition 5 requires commitments but no content or provenance check references `commitments`.
fix_instructions: Replace C5 with a boolean check that verifies commitments contain both restitution and privacy-compliant customer-notice commitments, including the required details.
